# Folder size: a folder holds at most 25 source files directly in it. Tests,
# generated files and the files of sub-folders do not count.
# `bun scripts/check-budgets.ts` checks it.
# Each line is a folder over the limit: its path, and its source files on the
# day it was listed. The check fails when the folder holds more than that.
# To get off the list: move the files of one sub-domain into a sub-folder.
# When the folder holds 25 source files or fewer, remove its line: the check
# fails a listed folder that is within the limit. Add no line here.
# `bun scripts/check-budgets.ts --tighten` lowers the numbers to today's.
apps/mobile/src/features/inbox 27
packages/engine/src/knowledge 34
